lines.text: David says the earth is the LORD's because He founded it upon the rivers.
The one who may stand in the LORD's holy place has clean hands and a pure heart.
He will receive blessing from the LORD, and such is the generation of those who seek the God of Jacob.
The gates are told to lift up so the King of Glory may enter, and he is the LORD, strong and mighty.
The call to the gates comes again, and the King of Glory is named the God of Abraham.
